title: Tensor-Hom adjunction for modules over a ringed space
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space (a topological space with a sheaf of commutative rings on its opens) and $\mathcal A,\mathcal G,\mathcal F$ $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $\mathcal A\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G$ be the tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], with $t_W:\mathcal A(W)\otimes_{\mathcal O_X(W)}\mathcal G(W)\to(\mathcal A\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G)(W)$ the components of the sheafification map, and $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ the sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom]; for $\eta\in\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)(W)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_W}(\mathcal G|_W,\mathcal F|_W)$ write $\eta_{W'}:\mathcal G(W')\to\mathcal F(W')$ ($W'\subseteq W$ open) for its components. Then for every $\mathcal O_X$-linear $\varphi:\mathcal A\to\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ there is a unique $\mathcal O_X$-linear $\tilde\varphi:\mathcal A\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$ with $\tilde\varphi_W(t_W(a\otimes g))=(\varphi_W(a))_W(g)$ for all opens $W$, $a\in\mathcal A(W)$, $g\in\mathcal G(W)$, and $\varphi\mapsto\tilde\varphi$ is a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal A,\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F))\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal A\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ of $\mathcal O_X(X)$-modules, natural in $\mathcal A$ (for $\alpha:\mathcal A'\to\mathcal A$: $\widetilde{\varphi\circ\alpha}=\tilde\varphi\circ(\alpha\otimes\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal G})$).
